en: Fixed sessions on a gateway-specific model name behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` ending with "Prompt is too long · automatic compaction failed" near 200K tokens instead of sending the request
zh: 修复了在自定义 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 下使用网关专属模型名的 session，在接近 200K tokens 时未发送请求，而是显示“Prompt is too long · automatic compaction failed”的问题
